tools.name: explain_bot_prediction
tools.description:
Narrative "why" for one bot's prediction

Generated text (LLM + match context: H2H, form, model signals) explaining a specific bot's prediction. Get valid `botId` values from `GET /bots` or `GET /matches/{slug}/bots`.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description:
Poll simulation status

Status of a simulation started with `POST /matches/{slug}/simulate`. Statuses: `queued` → `running` (includes `progress_pct`, `current_minute`, `current_score`) → `completed` (includes the full `result`) or `failed`. Poll every few seconds until terminal; jobs are kept 7 days and visible only to the key owner.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description:
Match details (metadata)

Public metadata for one match: teams, league, UTC kickoff, venue, score when available.

tools.name: get_match_ai_analyses
tools.description:
Pre-match AI analyses

Bot-generated text analyses, produced ~24h before kickoff. If the match is more than 24h away and nothing has been generated yet, returns `404 AI_ANALYSES_NOT_AVAILABLE` with an `available_from` timestamp.

tools.name: get_match_bot_predictions
tools.description:
Bot predictions + consensus

Every algorithmic bot with a prediction on the match, including global accuracy stats, plus the majority consensus (`signal` is STRONG when agreement ≥ 75%). Cache: 30 min.

tools.name: get_match_context
tools.description:
H2H, recent form, season stats

Pre-match context computed from PredictCamp's stored history (not a live feed): last 10 head-to-head meetings, last 5 finished matches per team, current-season aggregates. Cache: 1h.

tools.name: get_match_models
tools.description:
Statistical models bundle

All PredictCamp models for an upcoming match: Poisson, Elitul (Dixon-Coles + 10,000-iteration Monte Carlo), Elo, calibrated ensemble and proxy xG, plus `models_consensus` (agreement across models). Probabilities are percentages (0–100). Only available before kickoff — returns `422 MODELS_NOT_AVAILABLE` for finished matches.

tools.name: get_match_stats
tools.description:
Match statistics + goals

Possession, shots, corners, cards and goal events. Only for live or finished matches — returns `422 STATS_NOT_AVAILABLE` for upcoming ones.

tools.name: get_post_match_report
tools.description:
Post-match AI report + model accuracy

After full time: how well each model and bot predicted the result (`accuracy_score` 0–100), the best model, an AI narrative and key moments. Returns `422 POST_MATCH_NOT_AVAILABLE` until the match is finished and analyzed.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description:
Service health

Public status check for the API. No authentication required.

tools.name: list_bots
tools.description:
Catalog of available bots

All algorithmic bots with their metadata. Use the `id` field as `botId` in `GET /matches/{slug}/bots/{botId}/explain`. Names and descriptions follow `X-Locale`.

tools.name: list_matches
tools.description:
List matches with filters and aggregate signals

Paginated matches from the PredictCamp database. Each row is enriched with the algorithmic bot consensus and the ensemble model signal when available. List cache: 120s.

tools.name: simulate_match
tools.description:
Start an asynchronous match simulation

Starts a step-by-step Monte Carlo simulation with custom formations and model weights for an **upcoming** match. Returns **202 with a `job_id` immediately** — the simulation runs for `duration_seconds` in real time. **Do not retry this call.** Poll `GET /jobs/{jobId}` until `status` is `completed` (or `failed`), or receive the signed result on your `webhook_url` (HMAC-SHA256, `X-PredictCamp-Signature` header). Limit: **10 simulations / hour / key.**

model_weights.description: Weights per model (poisson, dixon_coles, monte_carlo, elo) — must sum to 1.0

bot_id.description: Optional bot that "commentates" the simulation (id from GET /bots)

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL for the result push (falls back to the API key's webhook); payload signed with HMAC-SHA256 (X-PredictCamp-Signature)
